title: Bound repeated pinned linked-artifact reads and preserve refresh grace
outcome: Linked refresh reuses safe prior data on unchanged bound inputs and preserves visibility on transient failures without accepting a replacement artifact.
acceptance: Deterministic counts show unchanged terminal linked runs avoid repeated pinned file reads, and unchanged active paths reuse safe reads after physical identity validation.
A transient read failure preserves existing visibility as intended, while a different physical identity, request, or result cannot settle the original run.
